\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]\scriptsize
\item \textit{Notes.} Cobidder = adjudication-anchored exposure label (not cartel membership). 
The main validation label is constructed from current scripts by matching ComprasNet-active direct CADE defendants to tender-items and identifying unique always-loser firms (win rate $=0$) that share at least one ComprasNet tender-item with those anchors; direct defendants are excluded. 
The frequent-loser flag is not used to construct the label; it is the award-layer score evaluated against the label. 
Of the 196 positives, 95 are frequent losers and 101 are not (composition, not a label restriction). 
The conservative benchmark restricts CADE cases to judgment dates $\leq$ 2025-02-26 under the SAME definition (this cutoff equals the latest judgment date, so it retains all 5 dated cases and excludes 2 undated cases). 
Counts are unique firms unless a column says pairs. AL = always-loser; FL = frequent loser (FL32, tenders\_count $\geq 32$). 
Legal-defendant roster (65) is not reproducible from the CADE rulings CSV (empty CNPJ column); shown for context.
\end{tablenotes}
